description: This file appears to be a shell script that defines and executes a series of tests for a Git and CVS integration, specifically testing a git-cvsserver setup, including repository cloning, checkout, diff, update, merge, and verification of repository states. It contains setup procedures, test case definitions, and validation routines related to version control systems.

methods.name: check_start_tree
methods.description: Prepares the environment for a new checkout test, resets and logs the starting state.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Verifies that the file content at a specific revision matches expected content by performing a 'git show' and comparing.

methods.name: check_end_tree
methods.description: Checks that the overall directory tree matches the expected list of files.

methods.name: check_end_full_tree
methods.description: Performs a full verification of the directory tree and the repository's latest commit tree with external 'git ls-tree'.

methods.name: check_diff
methods.description: Applies a diff file to a temporary sandbox and checks that the diff results match expected changes.
